fusions.name: Liana Swing
fusions.desc: Catches a target up to 7 tiles away with a rope of hair and swings you to it, landing a blow for 14 blunt damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Grip and Pummel
fusions.desc: Seizes the target in a fist of hair and pounds it for 5 blunt damage, leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Each hit has a 20% chance to hold it [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Picked Clean
fusions.desc: Strands comb through you and your allies, picking up to 2 conditions off each of you.

fusions.name: Bristling Display
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, every hair on you stands on end and you deal 25% more physical damage for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
